playercorpseforked:item-handbooktext-pla: Points at your corpses anywhere in the world, loaded or not. Right-click to target the nearest one, shift + right-click to cycle through them. Holding it (either hand) shows distance, direction and height difference; in the off-hand it also streams guiding particles. The needle turns toward the target. Server admins can also check the server-main.txt log for the exact coordinates of all corpses (creative mode finds everyone's corpses).
corpse-creation-failed: Corpse creation failed — your items were dropped at your death location. See server log for details.
corpsecompass-usage: Right-click: nearest corpse. Shift + right-click: next corpse.
